# Blue Door Architects

> Blue Door Architects is a luxury architecture and interior design studio based in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India. A sub-brand of The Palm Group. We design and deliver residential, commercial and hospitality projects across Gandhinagar and Ahmedabad — from initial brief to complete turnkey handover.

## Identity

- Studio name: Blue Door Architects
- Parent company: The Palm Group
- Founded: 2015
- Location: UNITY Office, Nr. Ekarth One, Unity Square, Sargasan, Gandhinagar, Gujarat — 382421, India
- Service area: Gandhinagar, Ahmedabad, and across Gujarat
- Website: https://bluedoorarchitects.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bluedoor_architects/
- Pinterest: https://in.pinterest.com/bluedoorarchitects/

## Contact

- Phone: +91 74340 06001

- Enquiries: https://bluedoorarchitects.com/#contact

## Services

Blue Door Architects offers end-to-end design and delivery services:

- **Architecture**: Considered, context-aware design across residential, commercial, hospitality and landscape typologies. Every site is treated as a unique proposition.
- **Interior Design & Decoration**: Interior design conceived as an extension of the architecture — not applied after the fact. Warm, minimal, material-led spaces.
- **Landscape Design**: Outdoor environments designed in concert with built form. Site-specific, never formulaic.
- **Turnkey Construction**: Complete project delivery from concept to key handover. The architect who designs your home is the same person accountable for handing you the key.
- **Bespoke Furniture**: Custom solid wood furniture designed and manufactured in-house through Unikraft, our furniture brand. 50,000 sq.ft. production facility in Gujarat.

## What Makes Us Different

- Single point of accountability: one studio handles architecture, interiors, landscape and furniture
- Selective practice: limited projects per year, every client receives undivided attention
- In-house manufacturing: Unikraft produces bespoke solid wood furniture, removing dependence on third-party suppliers
- Published work: featured in Architect & Interiors India (December 2025 and June 2026)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What types of projects does Blue Door Architects take on?**
Residential homes, villas, apartments, luxury residences, commercial offices, hospitality spaces, and landscape projects across Gandhinagar and Ahmedabad, Gujarat.

**Does Blue Door Architects handle turnkey projects?**
Yes. We offer complete turnkey delivery — from architectural design and interior design through to construction supervision and furniture. One team, one vision, one point of accountability.

**Where is Blue Door Architects located?**
UNITY Office, Nr. Ekarth One, Unity Square, Sargasan, Gandhinagar, Gujarat — 382421. We serve clients across Gandhinagar, Ahmedabad, and Gujarat.

**What is Unikraft?**
Unikraft is Blue Door Architects' in-house solid wood furniture brand. We design and manufacture custom bespoke furniture at our 50,000 sq.ft. production facility in Gujarat. The OBLIQUE collection by Riddhi Patel Santoki is our signature range.

**How do I start a project with Blue Door Architects?**
Visit https://bluedoorarchitects.com/#contact or call +91 74340 06001. We respond to every enquiry personally within one business day.

**What is the typical timeline for a residential interior project?**
A typical residential interior project takes 8–14 weeks from first briefing to handover, depending on scale and complexity.

**Does Blue Door Architects work with clients outside Gujarat?**
Our primary service area is Gandhinagar and Ahmedabad. We selectively take on projects elsewhere in Gujarat and for NRI clients planning homes in Gujarat.
